og.alt: Hotkeys: You have written this keydown listener before. It was the last time. 6–118× faster than tinykeys, hotkeys-js and mousetrap on a key that is not a shortcut (12 and 48 bindings, one run)

hero.alt: Schematic: pressing ⌘S (Ctrl+S off a Mac) reaches the Save handler registered with useHotkey('mod+s', save) and the browser's own save dialog is prevented. Pressing ⌘Z does nothing while the editor scope is off; once useHotkeyScope('editor') is active, the same keys reach Undo.

<title id="pq-hotkeys-t">Shortcuts that reach the right handler and nothing else</title>
<desc id="pq-hotkeys-d">Schematic: pressing ⌘S (Ctrl+S off a Mac) reaches the Save handler registered with useHotkey('mod+s', save) and the browser's own save dialog is prevented.
